{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat Recipes|Meat Recipes]]

==Ingredients==
*1 can cream of [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] soup
*1 can cream of [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushroom]] soup
*1 can mixed [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetables]]
*1 can white chunk chicken
*2 frozen [[Cookbook:Pie|pie]] [[Cookbook:Pie Crust|crusts]], thawed

==Procedure==
#Mix soup, vegetables, and chicken in a large bowl.
#Pour mixture into one of the pie crusts
#Cover with other pie crust and press around edges to seal.
#Cut several small slits in top of pie.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 375 °F for 30–40 minutes or until golden brown.
